findings.summary: Headless API-key surfaces still bypass checked generated Confect refs.
findings.details: S11-T02 adds headless/apiKeys specs and consumes them from the Settings route and HTTP auth path, but exact-head generated Confect spec/ref artifacts do not include headless/apiKeys. Product code compensates with a web-side HeadlessApiKeyRefs type assertion and runtime Ref.make construction for internal HTTP auth refs, so the client-hooks -> generated refs -> Confect specs boundary required by the task packet and AGENTS.md is asserted rather than enforced by generated contract artifacts at this head.
